title: Nursing Officer
qualification: Candidates must satisfy all three of the following: || 1. Academic Qualification: Must have passed 10+2 in the 10+2 system or its equivalent. || 2. Professional Qualification: Must hold a Diploma in GNM (General Nursing & Midwifery) or BSc Nursing from any Medical College and Hospitals of the State or any other institution duly recognised and approved by the Indian Nursing Council . || 3. Registration: Must have registered their name in the Nursing Council in the State of Odisha and must possess a valid Registration or Renewal Certificate as on the date of submission of the online application form . This certificate must be uploaded online at the time of application. || 4. Odia Language: Candidates must be able to speak, read, and write Odia, and must have satisfied one of the following: passed the Middle School Examination with Odia as a language subject; passed Matriculation or equivalent with Odia as the medium of instruction in non-language subjects; passed Odia as a language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above from a School recognised by the Government of Odisha or Central Government; or passed a test in Odia in M.E. School Standard conducted by the School & Mass Education Department.
age_limit: Candidates must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above 42 years as on the date of advertisement. Date of birth will be verified only from the HSC Certificate issued by the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha or an equivalent certificate from any recognised Board/Council/Indian University. || Age relaxation: || Candidates falling under more than one relaxation category are eligible for only the single most beneficial relaxation, except PwDs under SC/ST/SEBC who get cumulative relaxation as specified. Ex-Servicemen who have already secured regular State Government employment and availed the Ex-Servicemen benefit once are not eligible for reservation under Ex-Servicemen category for subsequent recruitment.

title: Sports Quota - MTS, Steno and Tax Assistant
qualification: Apart from sports achievement, each post requires a minimum educational qualification, and two of the three posts also have a mandatory typing or stenography skill requirement. Here is the post-wise breakdown.
age_limit: The age limit varies by post, and sportspersons get an additional relaxation on top of the standard limit. This section explains both the base age limit and the relaxation rules. || Tax Assistant:18 to 27 years || Stenographer Grade-II:18 to 27 years || Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS):18 to 25 years || As per DoPT O.M. No. 15012/3/84-Estt.(D) dated 12-11-1987 , sportspersons may be allowed a relaxation in the upper age limit of up to a maximum of 5 years ( 10 years for SC/ST candidates ). This relaxation applies only if the candidate fulfils all other eligibility conditions and furnishes a certificate in the prescribed format as per DoPT O.M. No. 1720781414772 dated 04-03-2024 .
selection_process: The selection process differs depending on the post applied for. Tax Assistant and Stenographer Grade-II go through two phases, while MTS selection is based on a single merit list.
